column1: # ISIDOR AND CECILLIE HAVE A SECOND CHILD, AND ISIDOR HAS A HEBREW NAME.
# Yad Vashem, Central Database of Shoah Victims' Names, searched by the SUBMITTER tab rather than
# the victim tab. Row 240. Read 11 October 2026.
# WHY IT WAS RUN. Row 240 had been sitting on one sentence since 21 September: "Yad Vashem indexes
# SUBMITTERS as well as victims: searching Khanan Rosenberg Varadi as submitter would give every
# page he filed, and a man who filled in two filled in more. THAT IS HIS OWN GENERATION OF THE
# FAMILY, written out by hand." It was never run. It has now been run and it was right.

column1: *** AND THE RESULTS COME IN THREE TABS, OF WHICH THE SECOND IS THE ONE NOBODY USES ***
column2: Results Regarding Victims, "RESULTS REGARDING DATA SUBMITTERS" and "Additional Results". The second tab, reached by appending #submitter, lists every record whose SUBMITTER matched the name searched. SEARCHING A SURVIVOR'S NAME THERE RETURNS THE DEAD HE WROTE DOWN. For Khanan Rosenberg Varadi: 1 victim result and 29 submitter results.

column1: and the synonym expansion is loose, so the set needs reading rather than counting
column2: of the 29, twenty-four are Rejdman, Ruza and Bocian-Bochin of Międzyrzec Podlaski and Mościska in Poland — a different submitter of a similar name, matched through Yad Vashem's synonym table. FIVE ARE BERLIN AND ALL FIVE ARE HIS.

column1: *** GEORG ROSENBERG — A SECOND CHILD OF ISIDOR AND CECILLIE, AND A NEW PERSON ***
column2: item 1057746 · BORN SCHLOCHAU 3 DECEMBER 1888 · father ISIDOR, mother CECILLIE · KAUFMANN, a merchant · of Berlin before and during the war · murdered, age 54, place of death AUSCHWITZ · submitted by KHANAN ROSENBERG VARADI, relationship SON. He is JENNY'S BROTHER, four years and two months older, out of the same house at Schlochau.

column1: the same man again, on a second Page by the same son
column2: item 423812 · same date of birth to the day, same town, same trade, same city · and the surname is also given as ROZENBERG.

column1: *** AND THE TWO PAGES DISAGREE ABOUT HOW HIS FATHER DIED ***
column2: 1057746 says AUSCHWITZ with no date. 423812 says THERESIENSTADT, 1942. ONE SON, TWO FORMS, TWO DEATHS. Berlin to Theresienstadt to Auschwitz is an ordinary route and the two may be two stages of it written down separately years apart, but THE ARCHIVE IS NOT PICKING ONE and neither is published as his death.

column1: *** THE REAL PRIZE: ISIDOR IS YITZKHAK AND CECILLIE IS SETZILIA ***
column2: 1057746 gives the parents as ISIDOR and CECILLIE; 423812 gives them as YITZKHAK and SETZILIA. Same son, same father, two forms — so these are the GERMAN AND HEBREW NAMES OF ONE COUPLE. That matters because a Jewish community register at Schlochau, if one is ever reached, will not be written in German.

column1: JENNY, confirmed and dated
column2: item 1122806 · JENNY LEIPHOLZ née ROSENBERG · born SCHLOCHAU 11 FEBRUARY 1893 · father Isidor, mother Cecillie · Berlin · murdered at AUSCHWITZ, age 50 · submitter Khanan Rosenberg Varadi, RELATIONSHIP NEPHEW. This is the Page row 240 was built on and it is now one of five rather than one of one.

column1: WILLI LEIPHOLZ, her husband, is in the same set
column2: Berlin, born 1887, murdered, Page of Testimony, same submitter. Already held in data/weinstrasse-pages-of-testimony.tsv; what is new is that it sits beside the other four and was written by the same hand.

column1: *** AND A SECOND FAMILY ENTIRELY: JOSEPH EHRLICH, THE GRANDFATHER ***
column2: Page of Testimony item 5369883, within victim record 13551143 · JOSEPH EHRLICH, born REETZ in Pomerania · of BERLIN, WARDENBURGSTRASSE 11 · deported Berlin to Theresienstadt 17 MARCH 1943 and dead there 1 FEBRUARY 1944 · submitted by KHANAN ROSENBERG VARADI, RELATIONSHIP GRANDSON. Khanan's other grandfather is Isidor, so JOSEPH EHRLICH IS HIS MOTHER'S FATHER — which makes him GEORG ROSENBERG'S FATHER-IN-LAW and names the family Georg married into.

column1: and his record is corroborated four ways, which the Rosenberg ones are not
column2: Ehrlich appears in the Bundesarchiv memorial list, the Berlin deportation list, the Theresienstadt inmate list AND the Page. THE PAGE DISAGREES WITH THE LISTS ON TWO FIELDS: it gives his birth as 7 NOVEMBER 1862 against the lists' 7 DECEMBER 1862, and his death as 1943 against the lists' 1 FEBRUARY 1944. The lists win on both.

column1: *** WHICH IS THE METHOD LESSON AND IT APPLIES TO EVERY PAGE IN THIS ARCHIVE ***
column2: A PAGE OF TESTIMONY IS A RELATIONSHIP DOCUMENT, NOT A DATE DOCUMENT. Written from memory, often decades later and often in another language, it is the best evidence there is for who was whose son and the worst for when. Where a Page and an official list disagree here, the list is right both times. The Pages' value is "SON", "NEPHEW", "GRANDSON" — three words no list carries.

column1: # ---------------- ONE RULED OUT, SO NOBODY RULES IT OUT TWICE ----------------
HONA VARADI, born 1920, is not him
column2: item 6281940, the only victim-tab result · "List of [female] Jewish survivors who were liberated from Bergen-Belsen, compiled in 1945", gender UNKNOWN, liberated at Bergen-Belsen. A synonym match on Hona/Khanan and a women's list. NOT KHANAN ROSENBERG VARADI and not evidence of his own birth year, which remains unknown.

column1: # ---------------- WHAT IT CHANGES FOR THE ROW, STATED WITHOUT INFLATION ----------------
*** STILL NOT THIS FAMILY, AND THAT HAS NOT MOVED AN INCH ***
column2: Jenny married a LEIPHOLZ of Berlin. NOTHING CONNECTS ANY ROSENBERG HERE TO THE SCHUBIN LEIBHOLZES OR TO ANY LUWINSKI, and nothing here is offered as doing so. Rosenberg is among the commonest Jewish surnames in Germany.

column1: what it does change
column2: row 240 opened with TWO FORENAMES AND NO DATES — "Isidor and Cecillie, parents of Jenny". It now has FOUR NAMED PEOPLE OF SCHLOCHAU WITH DATES: Isidor/Yitzkhak and Cecillie/Setzilia, and their children Georg born 3 December 1888 and Jenny born 11 February 1893. Plus a son-in-law's family, the Ehrlichs of Reetz, with a Berlin street address. IF A SCHLOCHAU REGISTER IS EVER REACHED THERE ARE NOW FOUR SEARCH TARGETS WITH DATES INSTEAD OF TWO NAMES WITH NONE — and that was the whole point of the row, which is Sally Leibholz's own Kreis.

column1: and the instrument half of the row is now closed
column2: the other Pages of Testimony submitted by the same nephew was the free test and it is done. What is left on 240 is the Schlochau civil registry itself, which is a letter to Archiwum Państwowe w Koszalinie or its Słupsk branch, not a search — and Geneteka cannot reach it either, which was measured the same day in data/geneteka-pomorskie-2026-10-11.tsv.

column1: on naming the submitter
column2: Khanan Rosenberg Varadi's name is printed by Yad Vashem on five public memorial records and this archive already carried it. HIS OWN BIRTH YEAR IS NOT KNOWN AND HE IS NOT BEING SOUGHT OR APPROACHED. He is named here because a Page of Testimony's whole evidential weight is that a named person swore to a relationship.
